name: IRONCLAD
source:
Welcome to IRONCLAD, a visual novel set in the fantasy realm of Noro, ruled by five factions all vying for power.  Forty years ago, the assassination of a prominent political figure plunged the nations into war, and now it seems history is repeating itself.  Navigate your way through this medieval realm full of drama, diplomacy, and a whole lot of relationships!

[From [url=https://thatrandomartist337.itch.io/ironclad]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《铁甲战士》，这是一部以诺罗奇幻王国为背景的视觉小说，由五个争夺权力的派系统治。四十年前，一位著名政治人物被暗杀，导致各国陷入战争，而现在历史似乎又在重演。在这个充满戏剧、外交和大量关系的中世纪王国中航行！

[来自[url=https://thatrandomartist337.itch.io/ironclad]Itch.io[/url]]
